---
title: "2026 Florida Democratic Primary for Governor"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

# Extract the 67 county files to a temporary folder and read the key columns
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

gov_dem <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_select = c(office = 12, candidate = 15, party = 16, votes = 19),
  quote = "",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party == "DEM") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)

# Plot total votes by candidate, ordered from most to fewest votes
ggplot(gov_dem, aes(x = total_votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Democratic Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official statewide vote totals by candidate",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
